QuestInfo.name: Traveling Around Maple 3
QuestInfo.0: After taking a stroll around Showa Town, I should start up a conversation with Skye.
QuestInfo.1: Skye offered to take me to Orbis. Once I get there, she advised me to look for Elma...
QuestInfo.2: I was able to meet up with Elma. Where will I go next?

0.0: Alright, isn't this place fun? Obviously there are some interesting people in this town. Ready to go to the next spot?

yes.0: Alright, I'll send you to Orbis the land of the elevated.
yes.1: Once you arrive there, talk to #eElma#n, and she'll take you to another spot.
yes.2: Oh yeah, if you step outside, you'll encounter cute yet very violent monsters, so be careful of them.

no.0: Hey,do you really like it here? There's plenty of time, so have yourself a ball here before leaving this place!

1.0: Welcome! What else did Skye tell you about this place? Orbis is a place where the air's clean, and everything seems elevated.
